input.title: Add missing field limits to the API reference
input.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

The API reference for reports does not currently state the limits applicable to the fields involved in the report operations. This change proposes adding clear documentation within the API reference section to include these limits, such as maximum lengths for report names and lists, as well as recipient numbers, to assist developers in understanding and utilizing these constraints effectively.
